blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Calapan City is prioritizing social services, with more funds earmarked for education, housing, senior citizens, persons with disabilities, farmers, fisherfolk, and informal settlers, Mayor Paulino Salvador Leachon said in his State of the City Address on Thursday, Oct. 1. The mayor announced that more funds would go directly to sectors that matter most to residents: education, housing, senior citizens, persons with disabilities, farmers, fisherfolk, and informal settlers. Leachon also reported substantial increases in education funding, including expanded scholarship programs, school facility upgrades, and direct financial aid to students from low-income households.
